bug_terrarium.look: a glass BUG TERRARIUM display case on a wooden stand: a clear glass tank with a wooden base and corner frame, holding a little greenery and a mounted INSECT specimen on display inside. A prized-bug display case, clearly made of glass.

easel.look: an artist's EASEL: a wooden tripod easel holding a small painted canvas.

globe.look: an antique GLOBE: a tilted spherical world map on a turned wooden floor stand.

gramophone.look: a GRAMOPHONE: a wooden box player with a large flared BRASS horn rising from the top.

lily_pad.look: a flat round green LILY PAD floating on water, seen from straight above, with a small notch in one side and maybe a tiny pink flower. Flat, just the pad.

plant_large.look: a large LEAFY HOUSEPLANT: a tall potted PALM with broad green fronds spreading up and out of a terracotta pot. Taller than a small potted plant.

room_divider.look: a folding ROOM DIVIDER / screen seen front-on: three or four tall hinged PANELS of muted patterned cloth in wooden frames, standing in a slight zigzag.

statue_bug.look: a carved STONE STATUE of a beetle on a square stone plinth, grey stone.

statue_stone.look: a carved STONE STATUE on a pedestal: a small weathered grey stone figure/bust standing on a square stone BASE/plinth. Clearly a carved statue, NOT a plain rock or pillar.

suit_of_armor.look: a standing SUIT OF ARMOR: a full plate-metal knight's armor on a stand, polished steel, a shield at its side.

telescope.look: a brass TELESCOPE on a wooden tripod, the tube angled upward toward the sky.

vase.look: a decorative ceramic VASE seen front-on: a rounded glazed pot with a narrow neck holding a small arrangement of flowers/stems. A small tabletop vase.
